objects.name: Detection technique coverage: aws-high-number-of-failed-authentications-for-user
objects.description: The following analytic detects an AWS account experiencing more than 20 failed authentication attempts within a 5-minute window. It leverages AWS CloudTrail logs to identify multiple failed ConsoleLogin events. This behavior is significant as it may indicate a brute force attack targeting the account.
